profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a public company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, traded on the NASDAQ under the ticker NVDA. Its most recently reported annual revenue was $215,938,000,000, covering the period ending January 25, 2026, as filed in a 10-K with the SEC under CIK 0001045810. The company's site focuses on its artificial intelligence and data science offerings, particularly its foundation model and inference infrastructure products.

The company describes its Nemotron line as a family of multimodal, open AI models built for agentic reasoning tasks including advanced math, graduate-level science, and visual understanding. According to the site, Nemotron models are available under the NVIDIA Open Model License, which permits use, modification, distribution, and commercial deployment without attribution, and NVIDIA publishes model weights, training datasets, and training techniques alongside the models. Specific models mentioned include NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, described as helping agents complete specialized tasks faster, and NeMo Switchyard, which the site describes as routing each step to the appropriate model. The site also highlights Nemotron Speech models for automatic speech recognition, text-to-speech, and neural machine translation, as well as Nemotron Retriever models for document understanding and retrieval-augmented generation. Bryan Catanzaro, identified as VP of applied deep learning research at NVIDIA, is cited on the site in connection with the vision behind Nemotron.

NVIDIA's second tracked product, NVIDIA NIM, is described as inference microservices enabling fast, enterprise-ready deployment of foundation models, available at build.nvidia.com and requiring an NVIDIA AI Enterprise license for production use. The site also references supporting tools including NVIDIA NeMo, NVIDIA Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, and open-source libraries SGLang and vLLM, as well as hardware platforms NVIDIA RTX PRO and NVIDIA DGX Spark. The held facts indicate 174 legal matters with California exposure recorded against the company, though no specific case details are present in the data.
